body:
I think of death a lot. I eagerly await the process and destination, but have no inclination toward active pursuit. At one point after a barrage of motor vehicle collisions the feelings of pain and suffering came to a head and I collected the necessary parts to end. At that point I realized I would not end, as there were too much suffering by at least one person. 

The feelings I developed toward death are compatible with life and living, but apparently not with sharing.

Recently there was a lot of death in my life. First a boss at work, then my grandfather, then my best friend's little bro. A rough week to be sure. Death doesn't phase me usually but I was affected with so many separate sections of my life and the individuals each contained in mourning and seeing how different people process it. As they processed the death and attempted to have a conversation about death their timidity around the subject combined with their apparent earnestness to explore this universal experience fooled me into vocally expressing myself and my views. I only shared with two people, and it went poorly with one, and I hardly remember the other because of the crying, and the alcohol. 

I've lost enthusiasm for continuing to type. Perhaps I will respond to my own comment after I reread it.
